name: Silk Road Tours Landing
summary: Uzbek national-style tour operator landing: sunrise logo intro that flies into a glass nav pill, adras hero, full-screen interactive globe that zooms into Uzbekistan's cities with photo panels, climate chart and attraction viewer, ikat and arch dividers, plan-your-trip doors, legal documents block and a contacts footer with photo credits.
useWhen: Building a travel agency or tour operator site with a route across several cities
Needing a whole page with an intro, an interactive map of places and a trust/legal block already wired
avoidWhen: Only a map or a hero is needed; take that part alone
An app or booking flow rather than a marketing page
source: Owner's own Uzbek tour-operator site; brand, logo, contacts, staff and legal documents replaced with neutral placeholders
